title: Adjust top navigation and move Reviews/Comments to Discuss & Engage section

requirements.text: Update the global header navigation so that only "Home" and "About" appear in the top-right navigation area, and remove the current top navigation items "Read", "Share", "Reviews", and "Comments".

quotes: home and about should be at top right ? remove read from top and share story from top remove reviews and comments

acceptanceCriteria: On all pages, the top header shows navigation links/buttons for "Home" (routes to "/") and "About" (routes to "/about") aligned on the top-right side of the header.
The top header no longer shows "Read", "Share" (or "Share Story"), "Reviews", or "Comments" navigation items.
Header layout remains responsive and usable on mobile and desktop (no overflow/cutoff).

requirements.text: On the Home page, add a lower-page "Discuss & Engage" section that provides access to "Reviews" and "Comments" by linking to the Discussions page with the appropriate mode (reviews/comments).

quotes: instead review and comments down in discuss and engage

acceptanceCriteria: The Home page contains a clearly labeled "Discuss & Engage" section below the hero/top area (i.e., not in the header).
The section includes a "Reviews" control that navigates to "/discussions" with search param mode set to "reviews".
The section includes a "Comments" control that navigates to "/discussions" with search param mode set to "comments".
There are no "Reviews" or "Comments" navigation items remaining in the top header.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose using existing UI components instead).
Do not modify any files listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (e.g., frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx).
Keep backend architecture unchanged (single Motoko actor); no backend changes are required for this request.
nonGoals: Do not change routing paths or add new pages; continue using existing routes (/, /about, /discussions).
Do not change story submission, reading, reviews, or comments backend logic.
Do not redesign the overall theme/colors beyond what is needed for the navigation/content move.
